en.answer:
In that case, the effect does not resolve.

(The <<12225>> that activated the effect remains in the Pendulum Zone)
en.question: If <<9153>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the Pendulum Effect of <<12225>>, how does this resolve?
en.title: If <<9153>> is activated in a chain to the activation of the Pendulum Effect of <<12225>>, how does this resolve?

ja.answer:
「<<12225>>」のペンデュラム効果の処理時に「<<9153>>」の効果が適用されている場合、効果処理は適用されません。
（効果を発動した「<<12225>>」自身はペンデュラムゾーンに残る事になります。）
